source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml VillagerGreek protoaction Gather rate AbstractTemple 0.1; techtree.xml ArchaicAgeGreek CommandAdd SetVillagerToGather on Temple; proto_unit_commands.xml SetVillagerToGather; game.cfg PrayerEfficiency*)
notes: Greek favor = villagers praying at a Temple (any Temple, no per-Temple or global cap in the files). Already modelled as the pantheon favor rule (src/data/pantheons/greeks.json favor.table, type templeWorkers): favor/s = N x M x (1/(N + 10.1111) + 0.01), N = praying villagers, M = 1 (+0.2 Zeus, +0.2 Golden Apples). The Temple also has a site command (SetVillagerToGather, 'Command a nearby villager to gather resources at or near this location') that sends the nearest villager to pray. Name = STR_ACTION_GATHER (no separate 'pray' string exists).

effects.note: Gather WorkRate x1.20 BasePercent on EconomicUpgraded vs AbstractTemple.

source: Game files 19.17020 (proto.xml flag SplitQueue on the 12 base heroes, only Greek heroes have it; string_table STR_LOADINGSCREEN_TIP_58; proto.xml TownCenter/VillageCenter/Fortress train lists; techtree.xml ClassicalAgeGreek/HeroicAgeGreek/MythicAgeGreek TrainPoints 0.90 on HeroShadowUpgraded)
notes: Training a hero is a normal Train action, but Greek heroes have their own queue: 'Greek Heroes can be trained while other units or technologies (including Age Ups) are in the queue.' (STR_LOADINGSCREEN_TIP_58). The simulator must NOT block villager production or an age-up at the TC/Village Center/Fortress while a hero trains. Each hero buildlimit 1. Heroes per god: Zeus Jason (Archaic, needs a Temple alive: JasonEnable) / Heracles (Classical) / Odysseus (Heroic) / Bellerophon (Mythic); Hades Ajax (AjaxEnable) / Achilles / Chiron / Perseus; Poseidon Theseus (TheseusEnable) / Atalanta / Hippolyta / Polyphemus. Costs: Archaic 100F 50W pop 2, 5 s; Classical 75F 175G 2 favor pop 3, 20 s; Heroic 250W 100G 4 favor pop 2, 25 s; Mythic 400G 6 favor pop 4, 30 s (all already in greeks.json). Village Center trainingrate 0.75 applies. Does the separate queue run at full speed in parallel with the main queue? The tip says yes; owner check welcome. Name is not an official string.
